Application Health Dashboard Overview. Identity API HTTP 500s rose from 5 to 7. Content API HTTP 500s dropped from 12k to 246 - [TinaCloud CloudWatch Dashboard](https://us-east-1.console.aws.amazon.com/cloudwatch/home?region=us-east-1#dashboards/dashboard/tinacloud-overview)

sections.heading: 5. TinaCloud PostHog Metrics
sections.body:
![](/uploads/sprint-129/commits.png)

Total Commits processed by TinaCloud over the last 6 months, total commits (aka spits) over the last month was 39,145 (down 3% on the previous period) - [PostHog Dashboard](https://us.posthog.com/project/237683/dashboard/615466)

![](/uploads/sprint-129/onboarding.png)

User onboarding over the last 7 days - New accounts were 7% last Sprint and are now 9% (13 of 151). Invited collaborators were 24% and are now 19% (27 of 143) - [PostHog Dashboard](https://us.posthog.com/project/237683/dashboard/615466)

![](/uploads/sprint-129/projects.png)

Organisation and project creation over the last 7 days - 153 new organisations, up from 130 last Sprint - [PostHog Dashboard](https://us.posthog.com/project/237683/dashboard/615466)

sections.heading: 6. TinaCMS PostHog Metrics
sections.body:
![](/uploads/sprint-129/dau.png)

Daily active users this month - peaking at 705 on 29 Sep, and at about 640 on 23 Oct this Sprint (dips are weekends) - [PostHog Dashboard](https://us.posthog.com/project/237683/dashboard/1284436)

![](/uploads/sprint-129/geo.png)

Distribution of unique TinaCMS users over the last 30 days - US is our top country with 1,563 users, down 176 on the prior 30 days, ahead of Germany on 633 and the UK on 516 - [PostHog Dashboard](https://us.posthog.com/project/237683/dashboard/1284436)
